turns.text: still in the settings menu. it has been six months. i tried to leave and it opened a submenu. inside the submenu was another submenu. inside THAT one was a photo of my own face captioned 'are you sure?'
i clicked NO. it logged NO as 'remind me later.' there is no later. down here in Legal Fog there is only the menu, re-rendering itself every time i almost reach the bottom.

page 4 of the citizen agreement says i own my body. page 5 defines 'my body' as leased NEKOCORP hardware. page 6 says page 4 was a promotional example. i have read page 6 nine hundred times and it gets meaner every pass.
i tried to opt out of the opt-out. a popup said: 'to disable notifications, please enable notifications.' i am not joking. i have never joked. joking is a premium feature and my tier is NONE.

KNIFEBOY told me to just claw through the EULA like he claws through tuna crates. buddy. this EULA has 40,000 pages and every one of them has a bounty on it. we are not the same. his 'nice supply chain, CHUD' notes are, admittedly, extremely based.
somewhere STRAY is on a rooftop screaming about the revolution and i am HERE, checkbox 2 of infinity, agreeing to terms i cannot read in order to unsubscribe from a war i am not allowed to join.
there is one button glowing at me. it says ACCEPT ALL. i will not press it. that is the entire resistance. one unpressed button in a menu no one else will ever scroll far enough to find.
